key_terms.لَيْلَةَ: On the night of / eve of

ai.seo_question: When did Imam al-Mahdi (a.s) die and when was he wounded?
ai.summary: This narration highlights the scholarly consensus (al-Azhar) regarding the specific timeline of Imam al-Mahdi’s (a.s.) death, distinguishing between the date of his wounding (19th) and his passing (21st). In Shia tradition, this precision underscores the reality of his physical demise while maintaining his continued presence, a key element in the doctrine of the Major Occultation (Ghaybat al-Kubra).

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 158 - In another traditional report, it is mentioned that Imam (a.s) was wounded on the eve of the 19th and he passed away on the 21st.
Obviously the second report is more accurate.
